(in-package :game-2048)

(defun slide-row (row)
  \"Slide and merge a four-cell ROW toward its first element.\"
  (let* ((tiles (remove 0 row))
         (result nil)
         (score 0))
    (loop while tiles do
      (let ((tile (pop tiles)))
        (if (and tiles (= tile (first tiles)))
            (let ((merged (* 2 tile)))
              (pop tiles)
              (push merged result)
              (incf score merged))
            (push tile result))))
    (values (append (nreverse result)
                    (make-list (- 4 (length result)) :initial-element 0))
            score)))

(defun copy-board (board)
  (let ((copy (make-array '(4 4) :initial-element 0)))
    (dotimes (row 4 copy)
      (dotimes (column 4)
        (setf (aref copy row column) (aref board row column))))))

(defun move (board direction)
  \"Return a moved copy of BOARD, score gained, and whether it changed.\"
  (unless (member direction '(:left :right :up :down))
    (error \"Unknown direction: ~S\" direction))
  (let ((result (make-array '(4 4) :initial-element 0))
        (score 0))
    (dotimes (line 4)
      (let ((cells
              (loop for offset below 4
                    collect (case direction
                              (:left (aref board line offset))
                              (:right (aref board line (- 3 offset)))
                              (:up (aref board offset line))
                              (:down (aref board (- 3 offset) line))))))
        (multiple-value-bind (slid line-score) (slide-row cells)
          (incf score line-score)
          (dotimes (offset 4)
            (let ((value (nth offset slid)))
              (case direction
                (:left (setf (aref result line offset) value))
                (:right (setf (aref result line (- 3 offset)) value))
                (:up (setf (aref result offset line) value))
                (:down (setf (aref result (- 3 offset) line) value)))))))
    (values result score (not (equalp board result)))))

(defun spawn-tile (board random-state)
  \"Return a copy of BOARD with a random 2 or 4 in an empty cell.\"
  (let ((empty (loop for row below 4 append
                     (loop for column below 4
                           when (zerop (aref board row column))
                             collect (cons row column)))))
    (when (null empty)
      (error \"Cannot spawn a tile on a full board.\"))
    (let* ((position (nth (random (length empty) random-state) empty))
           (value (if (< (random 10 random-state) 9) 2 4))
           (result (copy-board board)))
      (setf (aref result (car position) (cdr position)) value)
      result)))

(defun won-p (board)
  (loop for row below 4 thereis
    (loop for column below 4 thereis (= (aref board row column) 2048))))

(defun game-over-p (board)
  (loop for direction in '(:left :right :up :down)
        always (not (third (multiple-value-list (move board direction))))))

(defun print-board (board score output)
  (format output \"Score: ~D~%\" score)
  (dotimes (row 4)
    (dotimes (column 4)
      (if (zerop (aref board row column))
          (format output \"~6A\" \".\")
          (format output \"~6D\" (aref board row column))))
    (terpri output))
  (terpri output))

(defun play (&key (input *standard-input*) (output *standard-output*)
                  (random-state (make-random-state t)))
  \"Play 2048 using line commands w/a/s/d and q.\"
  (let ((board (make-array '(4 4) :initial-element 0))
        (score 0)
        (announced-win nil))
    (setf board (spawn-tile board random-state)
          board (spawn-tile board random-state))
    (print-board board score output)
    (loop
      (when (game-over-p board)
        (format output \"Game over.~%\")
        (return))
      (let ((line (read-line input nil nil)))
        (when (null line) (return))
        (let ((direction (and (= (length line) 1)
                              (case (char-downcase (char line 0))
                                (#\\w :up) (#\\a :left)
                                (#\\s :down) (#\\d :right)))))
          (cond
            ((and (= (length line) 1) (char-equal (char line 0) #\\q))
             (return))
            (direction
             (multiple-value-bind (moved gained changed) (move board direction)
               (when changed
                 (setf board (spawn-tile moved random-state))
                 (incf score gained)
                 (when (and (not announced-win) (won-p board))
                   (format output \"You won"'!~%")
                   (setf announced-win t))))
             (print-board board score output)
             (when (game-over-p board)
               (format output "Game over.~%")
               (return)))
            (t
             (format output "Invalid key.~%")
             (print-board board score output))))))))
EOF

(defpackage :game-2048-tests
  (:use :common-lisp))

(in-package :game-2048-tests)

(require :tester)

(defun check-equal (expected actual)
  (unless (equal expected actual)
    (error \"Expected ~S, got ~S\" expected actual)))

(defun check-true (value)
  (unless value (error \"Expected a true value, got NIL\")))

(defun check-false (value)
  (when value (error \"Expected NIL, got ~S\" value)))

(deftest slide-row-merges
  (multiple-value-bind (row score) (game-2048:slide-row '(2 2 2 2))
    (check-equal '(4 4 0 0) row)
    (check-equal 8 score))
  (multiple-value-bind (row score) (game-2048:slide-row '(2 2 4 0))
    (check-equal '(4 4 0 0) row)
    (check-equal 4 score))
  (multiple-value-bind (row score) (game-2048:slide-row '(0 2 0 2))
    (check-equal '(4 0 0 0) row)
    (check-equal 4 score)))

(deftest moves-copy-score-and-noop
  (let ((board (make-array '(4 4) :initial-element 0)))
    (setf (aref board 0 0) 2 (aref board 0 1) 2)
    (multiple-value-bind (result score changed) (game-2048:move board :left)
      (check-equal 4 (aref result 0 0))
      (check-equal 4 score)
      (check-true changed)
      (check-equal 2 (aref board 0 0)))
    (multiple-value-bind (result score changed) (game-2048:move board :up)
      (check-equal 0 score)
      (check-false changed)
      (check-true (not (eq result board))))))

(deftest spawn-is-reproducible
  (let* ((board (make-array '(4 4) :initial-element 0))
         (first (game-2048:spawn-tile board (make-random-state 123)))
         (second (game-2048:spawn-tile board (make-random-state 123))))
    (check-true (equalp first second))
    (check-true (member 2 (coerce first 'list) :test #'equalp))))

(deftest win-and-game-over
  (let ((board (make-array '(4 4) :initial-element 2))
        (full (make-array '(4 4) :initial-element 2)))
    (setf (aref board 1 1) 2048)
    (check-true (game-2048:won-p board))
    (check-false (game-2048:game-over-p full))
    (dotimes (row 4)
      (dotimes (column 4)
        (setf (aref full row column)
              (if (evenp (+ row column)) 2 4))))
    (check-true (game-2048:game-over-p full))))

(deftest play-uses-streams
  (let ((output (make-string-output-stream)))
    (game-2048:play :input (make-string-input-stream
                           (format nil \"x~%q~%\"))
                    :output output
                    :random-state (make-random-state 42))
    (let ((text (get-output-stream-string output)))
      (check-true (search \"Score: 0\" text))
      (check-true (search \"Invalid key.\" text)))))
EOF
